inputs.original_text:
Folks, the progressive agenda never stops trying to chip away at the fundamental building block of our society: the traditional family. Now we see cracks even within Fianna Fáil, where Dublin South-West TD John Lahart is complaining about inheritance tax exemption thresholds, calling the current system ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those without children. Lahart’s comments follow recent contributions from party colleagues on the need to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures. 

Let's call this what it is. For generations, passing down what you've earned through a lifetime of personal responsibility to your children has been the bedrock of cultural continuity and family stability. It rewards people for raising families and building a future for the next generation. Now, the modern, atomized lifestyle wants to dismantle that, demanding that the state re-engineer everything so that childless individuals get the exact same privileges as those who take on the sacred duty of parenthood. 

Mr. Lahart himself admitted the drift when he stated, ‘At [...]’ and if we let the cultural elites dismantle these distinctions, we lose the very incentives that hold a healthy, traditional society together. We need to stand up for authority, tradition, and the families who sacrifice to build a lasting legacy.

Dublin South-West TD John Lahart is out there whining about inheritance tax exemption thresholds, having the audacity to call the current system ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against people who chose not to have children. This comes right on the heels of his party colleagues pushing to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures. 

Let's call this what it is. For generations, passing down what you've earned through a lifetime of personal responsibility to your children has been the bedrock of cultural continuity and family stability. It rewards people for raising families and building a future for the next generation. Now, the modern, atomized lifestyle wants to dismantle that, demanding that the state re-engineer everything so that childless individuals get the exact same privileges as those who take on the sacred duty of parenthood. 

Mr. Lahart himself admitted the drift when he stated, ‘At [...]’ and if we let the cultural elites dismantle these distinctions, we lose the very incentives that hold a healthy, traditional society together. We need to stand up for authority, tradition, and the families who sacrifice to build a lasting legacy.
